about: Decoding patterns from late 1st grade through 4th grade (vowel teams and diphthongs, silent letters, soft c and g, -le, prefixes and suffixes, spelling changes, longer words, Greek and Latin parts). Each pattern has a g and 12-15 words. picture is an emoji where one shows the word clearly. distractors are 3 real or made-up words that differ in the pattern and are never homophones of the target. The game shuffles the options.

patterns.name: ou / ow as in cloud and cow
oi / oy as in coin and toy
aw / au as in paw and cause
ew / ue as in new and blue
ie as in pie and tied
soft c as in city and ice
soft g as in giant and cage
Silent letters: kn, wr, gn, mb
air / are / ear as in chair, care, bear
Doubling or dropping the e before -ing
ar / or / er / ir / ur in longer words
Changing y to i before -ed and -es
ie as in field and movie
